title: File:Colorado Recreational River, Colorado, Utah (35842291953).jpg
desc: The Upper Colorado River is a unique and beautiful recreation area, known for its diverse water features, wildlife and cultural landscapes accessible along the Colorado River Headwaters Scenic Byway.
